subject: Handoff: NimbleHealth onboarding & implementation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: Handoff: NimbleHealth onboarding & implementation plan

Hi team,

Thanks everyone for a productive close last week — NimbleHealth signed today for a Dedicated capacity seat and a 12-month commitment (see deal id RDW-DEAL-4872). Quick context for the handoff and what the customer expects in the next 3 weeks:

- Use case: embedding-powered clinical search + internal summarization for care teams.
- Initial scope: sandbox environment, data sync of EHR metadata (S3 export), and live inference via Redwood Dedicated.
- Go-live target: 2026-03-25 (pilot with 50 users).
- Success criteria: < 200ms 95th percentile latency on 512-token requests; embeddings batch job completes within nightly window; no PII storage in logs.

Attachments: Nimble_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (first draft), SOW-draft.docx.

Owner ask: Priyom, can you own the customer-facing onboarding and be the primary CS contact? Monica, please own the implementation plan and infra provisioning. I added Aisha from NimbleHealth on cc so you can coordinate times directly.

Open items I flagged during the sales cycle:
1) NimbleHealth asked for SOC 2 evidence and a copy of our data-retention policy.
2) They want a short performance runbook showing expected latency vs. concurrency on our Dedicated instance.
3) We committed to a 2-week test window with ability to iterate batching/quantization profiles.

Proposed next steps:
- Priyom/Monica: schedule a 30-min kickoff with Aisha this week (we suggested Thu 3/5 10-10:30 PT).
- Share security artifacts and SSO onboarding docs (Monica to coordinate with Security).
- Finalize SOW edits and sign; DocuSign link in related_links.

Thanks — happy to join the kickoff if you want a quick intro.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-1293

Attachments: Nimble_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (11 KB), SOW-draft.docx (24 KB)

- Can you confirm whether they will send nightly EHR exports to a staging S3 (we'll want the bucket + role before provisioning)?

Internal notes for CS:

- Connor O'Brien can help with SSO/KMS integration if we need to exchange key material.
- Monica: please attach the performance runbook draft and a short SOC2 artifact pack once available.

I will propose Thu 3/5 10:00 PT (30 mins) and include the internal kickoff agenda: 1) Introductions & team roles, 2) Data flow and security requirements, 3) Staging provisioning timeline, 4) Pilot success criteria and reporting.
